title: KCP relation_assert result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §10.3, §11.6.1 space/content mutation + worker families)
description: CommandResult.result payload for relation_assert (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The asserted SpaceRelation projection with relation_class pinned to semantic_assertion (gap notes KG4/KG23/KG30).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

objectRefTriple.description: Exact endpoint pin {object_ref, revision, digest} (§10.2 SpaceRelation from_ref/to_ref; exact object refs always include the applicable revision and canonical digest, §10 preamble).

relationKind.description: Closed RelationKind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). A relation confers no visibility, admission, truth, trust, acceptance, scheduling, execution, or permission (§10.2).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

revision.description: Immutable record: fixed revision 1 (§10 preamble; gap note KG30).

relation_class.description: The public/worker relation_assert schema always creates semantic_assertion (§10.2 spelled); structural relations are recorded only by the owning Kovee service through internal operations (gap note KG23).

spaceRelation.description: SpaceRelation projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG23/KG30).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
